auth.emailStep: We will email you a six-digit code. No password to remember.
auth.codeSentTo: We sent a code to {email}. It expires in ten minutes.
auth.signInToStart: Sign in to set up an event.

events.title: Your events
events.noneHint: Set one up, print its QR code, and put it on the table.
events.createHint: You can change any of this later. Photos are kept for 90 days after the date you set.
events.useAsBooth: Use this phone as the booth
events.endConfirm: End the party? Guests can no longer take photos, and the booth stops. The photos are kept.

dashboard.qrHint: Guests scan this to start the booth from their own phone. They can also just tap the booth screen.
dashboard.shareUnsupported: Could not share on this device.
dashboard.devicesHint: Stopping a booth frees that phone without ending the party.
dashboard.stopBoothConfirm: Stop the booth on this phone?
dashboard.stopBoothHint: The party keeps running. Any phone can take over as the booth.
dashboard.unpairPrinterHint: It will leave your wifi and offer its “PhotoLu-Setup” network again, so you will need to set it up from scratch. Photos already printed are kept. To use it at a different party, go back and add it there instead.
dashboard.waitingToPair: Waiting for the pairing code to be used
dashboard.downloadOnWeb: Downloading everything works in the browser. Open this event on a computer.
dashboard.downloadEmpty: There are no photos to download yet.
dashboard.downloadFailed: The download did not finish. Try again.
dashboard.pairingCodeHint: The code lasts 15 minutes and works once. The printer joins your wifi and the setup network disappears.
dashboard.pairingCodeExpired: That code has expired. Make a new one.
dashboard.guestLinkHint: Send this to your guests. They can also scan the QR code on the booth screen.
dashboard.guestLinkNotYet: Start the event before sending this — until then the link will not open.
dashboard.pairStep1: Have your wifi name and password to hand.
dashboard.pairStep2: Plug the printer box in and turn the printer on.
dashboard.pairStep3: On this phone, join the wifi network “PhotoLu-Setup”. It has no password.
dashboard.pairStep4: Scan the QR code on the printer, or open photolu.local
dashboard.movePrinter: Use a printer from another event
dashboard.movePrinterHint: Already set up and on your wifi. No code needed — it just changes which party it prints for.
dashboard.availablePrintersHint: Set up already and on your wifi. Add one to this party — no code needed.
dashboard.newPrinterOnly: Only for a printer that has never been connected. One already on your wifi is added from the list above.
dashboard.pairStep5: Enter your wifi details and the code above.
dashboard.backgroundHint: Artwork behind the photos on every print. Landscape, 3:2 — 1800×1200 is ideal.
dashboard.backgroundNone: Plain white. Every print will look like this until you add one.
dashboard.backgroundFailed: That picture could not be uploaded. Try again.
dashboard.backgroundTooBig: That picture is too large. Keep it under 10MB.
dashboard.backgroundOnWeb: Choosing a picture works in the browser. Open this event on a computer.
dashboard.retakesHint: How many times a guest can delete their photo and go again, keeping their place at the front.

retention.deletedToday: These photos are being deleted today.
retention.ownerCountdown: Everything is deleted on {date} — download it before then.

daysLeftAction.one: {count} day left — download them before they go.
daysLeftAction.other: {count} days left — download them before they go.

retention.guestFull: Your photos are saved until {date} and then deleted. You can delete them sooner from this page whenever you like.

booth.title: Booth mode
booth.notBuiltHint: This is where the countdown, the shots and the montage will live. It is being built against the real API rather than fixtures, since the risk is in timing and uploads, not layout.
booth.rotateHint: The booth takes landscape photos. Upright, most of the picture would be cropped away.
booth.pair: Use this phone as the booth
booth.pairHint: This phone will take the photos. Keep it plugged in, and leave this screen open.
booth.needsLiveApi: Booth mode needs the real API. Run: npm run client:live, with npm run server in another terminal.
booth.notSignedIn: Sign in before using this phone as the booth.
booth.scanToTrigger: Scan to start from your own phone
booth.stoppedByOwner: This booth was stopped from the event. Start it again to carry on.
booth.wrongEvent: This phone was set up for “{event}”. Use it for this event instead?

guest.welcomeHint: Tap to start. The booth will take {count} photos.
guest.boothOfflineHint: Nobody has the booth switched on right now. Ask whoever is hosting.
guest.yourTurnHint: Stand in front of the booth and tap when you are ready.
guest.missedTurn: You missed your turn, but you are still in the queue.
guest.shareUnsupported: Could not share on this device.

common.offlineHint: You are still signed in. Check the server is running (npm run server) and try again.
